hero.title: Real-time Blockchain Risk Analysis with sub-100ms response
hero.subtitle: UAE7Guard protects transactions before signing using multi-vector threat detection, external intelligence, and transparent confidence scoring.

scanner.title: Security Scanner Portal
scanner.description: Submit an Ethereum address to run instant V2.5 risk analysis across blacklist, smart-contract, poisoning, flash-loan, and external intelligence modules.

services.title: Core Protection Modules
services.addressPoisoningBody: Levenshtein and prefix/suffix similarity checks detect lookalike wallets with low-latency execution.
services.contractAuditBody: Bytecode pattern checks and dangerous opcode heuristics flag known exploit patterns before approval.
services.riskScoringBody: Weighted scoring across age, behavior, value flow, and external intelligence yields a transparent allow/review/block decision.

architecture.title: Technical Architecture
architecture.p2: Threat module execution (poisoning, contract, flash loan)
architecture.p3: External intelligence scoring with graceful degradation
architecture.stackBody: App Router + typed API route + optimized JavaScript risk engine + Wagmi wallet bridge + next-intl localization.

dashboard.title: Security Operations Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Monitor wallet risk, simulate transactions before signing, and configure notifications for live threat signals.

developers.title: Developer Portal
developers.subtitle: Integrate UAE7Guard decisioning into your dApp, backend gateway, or signing policy workflow.
developers.apiBody: Use POST /api/analyze for transaction risk analysis in under 100ms with confidence and module-level breakdown.
developers.sdkBody: Risk engine is separated in lib/optimized_risk_engine.js for direct server-side use in any Node.js environment.
developers.docsBody: Review PRODUCTION_GUIDE.md and DEPLOY_COMMANDS.md for deployment, environment setup, and domain configuration.
